title: Circle or square?
topic: A beginner p5.js activity that uses random() and if/else to fill a grid with circles or nested squares.
summary:
A one-sheet mini-zine that walks beginners through a p5.js sketch: set up a canvas, 
build a grid with nested loops, then let random() choose a circle or a nested square.

intake.maintainer_notes:
Three language editions exist (Turkish, English, French).

Reader-order and Print-ready contain the black-and-white, white-background English edition (`read-bw-en.pdf`, `print-bw-en.pdf`), recommended for toner-friendly printing.

Additional files: black-and-white Turkish and French editions (`read-bw-tr.pdf`, `print-bw-tr.pdf`, `read-bw-fr.pdf`, `print-bw-fr.pdf`) and `color.zip`, containing the full-color reader-order and print-ready PDFs for all three languages (`read-en.pdf`, `print-en.pdf`, `read-tr.pdf`, `print-tr.pdf`, `read-fr.pdf`, `print-fr.pdf`).

Typography: Space Grotesk and JetBrains Mono (SIL Open Font License).

activity_type: Self-guided activity; also works as a short workshop or classroom exercise.
materials:
- A computer with a web browser
- The p5.js Web Editor (editor.p5js.org), or Processing in p5.js mode
- Optional, for the paper zine: a printer, one sheet of A4 paper, and scissors
